description:
List the marketplace's categories and their subcategories, with the slugs search_listings takes and each name in English and Vietnamese. Needs no sign-in and takes no arguments.

Call it before search_listings when the person names a kind of thing ("a scooter", "a room to rent") and you need its `category` or `subcategory` slug. The list rarely changes, so one call per conversation is enough.

Returns `categories`, each with `slug`, `name`, `name_vi` and `subcategories` (each with `slug`, `name` and `name_vi`).
name: list_categories

categories.description: Every category buyers can browse, in the site's order; teacher profiles are not served here

name.description: The category's name in English, as the site shows it

name_vi.description: The category's name in Vietnamese, as the site shows it

slug.description: The category slug: pass it to search_listings as `category`

subcategories.description: The subcategories of this category; empty when it has none

slug.description: The subcategory slug: pass it to search_listings as `subcategory`, with its category

title: List categories
